name: find_events
description: Find previously recorded events by optional filters. Use before creating an event that might already exist. An empty result means no matching event was recorded.

tags.description: Optional tags; event must share at least one.

created_at_from.description: Optional inclusive lower bound on created_at_game_time.

created_at_to.description: Optional inclusive upper bound on created_at_game_time.

query.description: Optional text search. Case-insensitive substring match against summary OR details (details searched as JSON text). An event matches if the query appears in either field.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return. Defaults to 20.
